title: Q-Mol Molecular ADMET Dataset
subtitle: 7,768 molecules with calculated ADMET descriptors (QED, logP, TPSA, Lipinski, PAINS, Veber)
description:
This dataset contains molecular structures (SMILES) and computed ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, Toxicity) descriptors harvested from PubChem. It is intended for virtual screening, cheminformatics, and drug discovery pipelines.

## Columns
- **cid**: PubChem Compound ID
- **smiles**: Canonical SMILES string
- **name**: Compound name (if available)
- **mw**: Molecular weight (Da)
- **logp**: Calculated octanol-water partition coefficient
- **tpsa**: Topological polar surface area (Å²)
- **hbd**: Hydrogen bond donors
- **hba**: Hydrogen bond acceptors
- **qed**: Quantitative Estimate of Drug-likeness (0-1)
- **lipinski_pass**: Passes Lipinski's Rule of Five (1=yes, 0=no)
- **veber_pass**: Passes Veber rules (1=yes, 0=no)
- **pains_hit**: Contains PAINS substructure alert (1=yes, 0=no)

## Statistics
- Total entries: 7,768
- Lipinski-pass: 7,187 (92.5%)
- Mean QED: 0.067 (note: this may indicate data quality issues)

## Source
- Platform: Q-Mol (http://photon-bounce.com/qmol)
- Harvested from: PubChem
- RDKit-validated descriptors
